text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Traditional leader of the Kxoe tribe, Klippie George, said he is consideping legal action against the Ministry of Prisons and Correctional Services over its plans to close community-based tourism camps near Popa Falls, to make way for a rehabilitation centre.

- Namibia will not allow South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission to hold hearings in the country as it could interfere with its own efforts of reconciliation, Foreign Minister Theo Ben said.
